mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_attachment ( original_file_nm, stored_file_nm, file_path, file_extension, content_type, file_size, status, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{originalFileNm}, #{storedFileNm}, #{filePath}, #{fileExtension}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO basic_attachment_link ( attachment_id, target_type, target_id, sort_order, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{attachmentId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM basic_attachment_link al JOIN basic_attachment a ON al.attachment_id = a.id WHERE al.target_type = #{targetType} AND al.target_id = #{targetId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY al.sort_order ASC, a.id ASC
